لؤلؤة: لُؤْلُؤَةٌ A pearl: pl. لَؤْلُؤٌ (S, K) and لَآلِئُ: (S:) [or rather, لُؤْلُؤٌ is a coll. gen. n., of which لُؤْلُؤَةٌ is the n. un.]. === Also, ‡ A wild cow; syn. بَقَرَةٌ وَحْشِيَّةٌ [a species of bovine antelope]. (K.)
لؤلئي: لُؤْلُئِىٌّ : see preceding paragraph; and لَأّلٌ.
لؤم: لَؤُمَ 1 He was base, base-born, low, ignoble, ungenerous, mean, sordid; (S:) contr. of كَرُمَ. (K.) See لَئِيمٌ. === لَأَمَ: see also ظَاهَرَ.
لؤمة: لُؤَمَةٌ , (S, K,) or 🡻لُؤْمَةٌ, (M, IB,) The whole apparatus, or gear, of the plough: (AHn, S, M, K:) or its iron [or share] and its wooden parts: (M:) or the سِنَّة [or ploughshare] with which the earth is ploughed up, and which, when upon the plough, is termed عِيَانٌ, pl. عين: (IAar, TA:) the سِكَّة. (IB, TA.) See عِيَانٌ.
